policy: Curated familiar named landmarks within 1000 ly and approximately absolute V <= +2; Altair retained at +2.21. Not a complete magnitude-limited sample.

10pc-0117.absoluteMagnitudeMethod: Johnson V and inverse-parallax distance; no extinction correction
10pc-0117.physicalParameters: SIMBAD mesFe_h/mesDiameter ranked measurements, Allende Prieto & Lambert 1999 evolutionary models, McDonald et al. 2012 SED models, and reviewed primary papers; see row notes
10pc-0117.luminosityMethod: McDonald et al. 2012 SED luminosity where available; otherwise Stefan-Boltzmann scaling R^2 (T/5772 K)^4 when both inputs are adopted
